theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: Gold Steady as Traders Assess Impact of Hormuz Flare-Up on Rates
top_news.summary: Gold moved in a narrow range as traders assessed the impact of a reported Iranian attack in the Strait of Hormuz on the Federal Reserve’s path for interest rates.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 7
top_news.summary: Oil extended gains after a report that Iran attacked “hostile targets” in the Strait of Hormuz, with Tehran seeking to bar US ships from the critical waterway in a deal with Oman.

top_news.title: Mexico Arrests Ex-Governor Over 2014 Student Abduction Case
top_news.summary: Mexican authorities detained a former governor over charges he concealed evidence in the more than decade-old abduction and presumed murder of dozens of students training to be teachers, one of the country’s most infamous criminal cases.

top_news.title: Kirin Pushes Into Vitamin Sales With $1.4 Billion Jamieson Deal
top_news.summary: Kirin Holdings Co. shares rose 2.4% to near record levels after the Japanese beverage maker announced a deal to acquire Toronto-based Jamieson Wellness Inc. that values the Canadian vitamins and supplements maker at about C$2 billion ($1.4 billion).

top_news.title: Singapore's DBS CEO Sees AI Costs Falling in ‘Token Paradox’
top_news.summary: DBS Group CEO Tan Su Shan sees AI costs trending down with more use of tokens, driven by what she calls the 'paradox of token spend.' She emphasizes that the bank maintains an open architecture, staying open-minded and avoiding being 'too wedded' to a model or any one provider. In a wide-ranging interview with Bloomberg's Haslinda Amin, Tan also outlines key growth areas, highlighting Taiwan as the bank's most exciting market opportunity in the next two to three years. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Fed's Musalem Expresses Preference to Raise Rates
top_news.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis President Alberto Musalem explains why he expressed a preference to raise rates at the Federal Open Market Committee's July meeting. Speaking at an event in São Paulo, Musalem also discusses the outlook for inflation. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Fed's Musalem Sees Need for 'Meaningful Restraint' on Inflation
top_news.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis President Alberto Musalem says policymakers can't afford to tolerate higher inflation while they wait for the possibility of stronger productivity growth. He speaks at an event in São Paulo. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Trex CEO on Earnings, Consumer Demand For Deck Materials
top_news.summary: Trex CEO Adam Zambanini joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the deck materials company's latest earnings results, the company's total addressable market, push into the Southern Sunbelt, customer demand, and more. He speaks with Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Japan Small Caps Face Survival Race as Topix Cull Looms
top_news.summary: Japan’s Topix stock index is poised for its biggest overhaul, with more than 600 companies — over a third of its constituents — likely to be gradually removed under new eligibility rules, according to analysts’ estimates.

top_news.title: Big Take: The situation at Situational Awareness
top_news.summary: On today’s Big Take podcast, hedge fund reporters Katherine Burton and Hema Parmar join Sarah Holder to break down the rise of 24-year-old ‘Nostradamus of AI’ Leopold Aschenbrenner, the meltdown of his hedge fund Situational Awareness and whether the episode exposes broader hedge fund vulnerabilities. (Source: Bloomberg)
